caption: The drawing features a sleeveless, collarless vest depicted in a light beige or off-white color. The vest has a diamond grid pattern covering its surface, likely meant to represent quilting or embroidery, drawn with thin, dark lines. On the left front panel of the vest, there is an additional decorative vertical band running from the shoulder to the bottom, consisting of alternating blue and gold diamond shapes. The vest is open at the front and features a series of parallel horizontal buttonholes, outlined in dark blue, but with no visible buttons. There are two slanted, rectangular pockets near the bottom on either side, also outlined in blue. The inner side of the vest, visible at the opening and bottom, is a slightly lighter shade. The background is plain, with a uniform light beige color.
title: Waistcoat
